title: Challenge Upcycle
body_text: Mina: Did you know that we can turn trash into something new and valuable? We can even make an artwork out of it. This process is upcycling. It is reusing trash creatively. Today, my dog tore my bag apart, so I needed a new bag. Instead of buying a new one or fixing the old one, I decided to upcycle my old jeans. Jeans are strong, so they are perfect for a bag. I then found a how-to for making a bag from old jeans on the Internet and made a bag. I wanted to decorate the bag, so I used the pins and buttons from my old dresses. I showed the bag to my friend, Suna, and she said that it looked unique and very nice!

blank_filled.why: 학습지 1번 「Which of the following best fills the blank?」 의 ⓒ. 다른 선지(ⓐ a kind of trash · ⓑ a new type of a bag · ⓓ reducing food waste)는 앞 문장 「This process is upcycling」의 풀이가 될 수 없다. 원장 확인 필요.
